title: resourceDatabase
responsibility: Opens the shared private SQLite protocol with equivalent Bun and Node statement adapters.

inputs.name: resourceDatabase.home
inputs.description: Directory used for the queue database; if it does not exist, it is created recursively with mode 0700. The function opens or creates queue.sqlite inside this directory.

outputs.name: resourceDatabase
outputs.description: Open queue database handle with exec, query, and close methods, backed by Bun SQLite directly or a Node DatabaseSync adapter. It creates the resource_jobs and resource_state tables and sets user_version to 1 after accepting only versions 0 or 1.

errors.name: UnsupportedResourceQueueSchemaError
errors.description: For a user_version other than 0 or 1, the function closes the database and throws UnsupportedResourceQueueSchemaError('Unsupported resource queue schema'); filesystem, module-loading, and SQLite calls can also throw their underlying errors.
